name: 7th Legion Base Camp
summary: The 7th Legion Base Camp serves as an Alliance military staging ground in the southern reaches of Silverpine Forest. Headed by General Marstone, the heavily fortified camp stations dwarven infantry and vanguard forces attempting to project Alliance power against the Forsaken.

sections.title: An Alliance Staging Ground
sections.body: Tucked against the rugged mountain terrain near the southern edge of Silverpine Forest, the 7th Legion Base Camp represents an audacious Alliance foothold deep within contested northern lands. Guarded by stern dwarven infantry, this outpost functions as a forward base of operations headed by General Marstone. Operating in direct proximity to the Forsaken territories, the encampment coordinates reconnaissance and military maneuvers aimed at checking Undercity's expanding grip over Lordaeron.

faq.q: What is the 7th Legion Base Camp?
faq.answer: It is an Alliance military forward operating post in southern Silverpine Forest, established to conduct operations and monitor Forsaken movements across the region.
The encampment is headed by General Marstone, an Alliance officer directing the forces and planning operations against the local Horde presence.

faq.q: Why are dwarves stationed in Silverpine?
faq.answer: Dwarven infantry form the backbone of this detachment's ground defenses, providing veteran shock troops to anchor the Alliance's presence in hostile territory.

faq.q: Why is the Horde concerned about this outpost?
faq.answer: An organized Alliance military encampment right on the borders of Silverpine poses a direct threat to Undercity's regional ambitions and security, making it a prime target for disruption.

angles.text: An isolated yet resolute bastion, the camp gives the Alliance a critical strategic foothold to challenge Forsaken supremacy in Silverpine.
The camp is a dangerous nest of living soldiers at the kingdom's threshold, demanding watchful scouting and swift action from the Forsaken.
